result.summary: Replaces the external Boost.Test unit test framework with an in-tree test runner and assertion framework implemented in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Implements expression decomposition to display operand values automatically upon check failures while providing backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims. Removes Boost.Test dependencies, options, and workarounds across CMake, depends, vcpkg, and Guix build scripts.
result.problem: Boost.Test adds external dependency overhead, requires platform-specific workarounds in Guix and depends, and has inconsistent assertion macros that often omit expression values on failure or require specialized macro variants.
evidence: RFC #34666 ('[rfc] Replacing Boost Unit Test Framework?') and issue #8670 ('Replacing Boost Test Framework') document long-standing interest in eliminating Boost.Test.

PR description demonstrates that Boost.Test assertions like BOOST_CHECK and BOOST_CHECK_MESSAGE omit operand values on failure, whereas the new framework decomposes expressions to print operand contents for custom types.

enables: Incremental migration of unit tests from legacy BOOST_* macros to native CHECK, REQUIRE, and TEST_CASE macros.

result.scope_notes: The large file count (~170 files) is overwhelmingly mechanical, driven by a scripted-diff changing unit test header includes from Boost to the new framework. The substantive logic is isolated to src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} (~1300 LOC) and build configuration files.
result.changed_since_previous: Added commits to require stringify or explicit CHECK_NO_DISPLAY opt-out, wrap logical and bitwise expressions (&, &&, ||) for expression decomposition precedence, drop low-usage macros (BOOST_FAIL, BOOST_TEST_INFO), inline CRecipient construction to silence a GCC 12 warning, and add missing operator<< display overloads.
result.card: This pull request replaces Boost.Test across all unit tests with an in-tree test runner in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Boost.Test imposes dependency maintenance costs, requires build-system workarounds in Guix and depends, and features fragmented assertion macros that often omit operand values when tests fail. Eliminating Boost.Test has been an ongoing objective discussed in RFC #34666 and issue #8670. While touching ~170 files, the changes across test suites are almost entirely a mechanical include migration, with legacy BOOST_* macros retained as shims to minimize rebasing friction for other open PRs.

risk.why: Mistakes could break test compilation or unit test runners across platforms, but cannot alter consensus, node behavior, or release binaries.
